definitions.gloss: to thrust into; to plunge; to ram into
definitions.explanation: To forcefully insert or push something into a space or container. Often used for physical actions.

definitions.gloss: to dive into; to rush into; to charge
definitions.explanation: To enter a place or situation quickly and forcefully.

definitions.gloss: to butt in; to make a witty retort; to tsukkomi
definitions.explanation: In comedy and conversation, to make a sharp comeback or point out something absurd. The 'tsukkomi' role in manzai comedy.

examples.japanese: ⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To thrust one's hand into a pocket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かばん→かばん：00637_kaban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I shoved the things into my bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}んで⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked with my hands thrust into my pockets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ガードレール→ガードレール：06517_gaadoreeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The car crashed into the guardrail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}んで⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A truck came crashing into the store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{込|こ}んだ→乗り込む：04618_norikomu⟧。
examples.english: I rushed into the taxi in the rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: I was immediately called out on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}まなかった。
examples.english: No one made a retort to that joke.
examples.notes: ボケに{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む is a set phrase in comedy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おかしな→おかしい：00875_okashii⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、{突|つ}っ{込|こ}みどころ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{満載|まんさい}→満載：13320_mansai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: His story had so many strange points that there was plenty to call out.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
Both intransitive and transitive depending on usage.
・Intransitive: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む (car crashes into wall)
・Transitive: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む (thrust hand into pocket)

COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - to thrust into one's pocket
・⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - car crashes/rams into
・⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - to make a retort (comedy)
・⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - to delve deeply into

COMEDY USAGE:
In Japanese manzai comedy, the ⟦ツッコミ→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧ (straight man) uses this action to respond to the ⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧ (funny man). The term has become a verb for making witty retorts in everyday conversation.
